title: My Busy Week
text:
My name is Ali. I have a busy week. On Monday I go to school. On Tuesday I play football with my friends. On Wednesday I visit my grandmother.

On Thursday I read a book in the library. On Friday I help my mother in the kitchen. On Saturday we go to the beach. On Sunday I rest at home.

questions.text: What does Ali do on Tuesday?
options: He plays football with his friends

questions.text: Where does Ali read a book on Thursday?
Why does Ali probably rest at home on Sunday?
options: Because he does not like the beach
Because he has had a busy week

questions.text: How does Ali probably feel about spending Saturday at the beach?
options: He is bored with his family
He likes spending time with his family
He does not like the sea

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
a place where you can borrow books
the mother of your mother or father
to relax and stop working or moving

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Meşgul bir haftam var. Pazartesi okula giderim. Salı günü arkadaşlarımla futbol oynarım. Çarşamba günü büyükannemi ziyaret ederim.
Perşembe günü kütüphanede bir kitap okurum. Cuma günü annemize mutfakta yardım ederim. Cumartesi günü plaja gideriz. Pazar günü evde dinlenirim.
